summary: The package is scope-confined and its supplied checks pass, but the comparator normalizes any five hybrid all_gather_into_tensor calls as owner exchange without authenticating their shape, dtype, numel, or relationship to the frozen ownership plan. Arbitrary collectives can therefore produce a false full PASS.

blockers.evidence: Replacing every G0/G1 owner all-gather record with float64 input shape [7]/numel 7 and output shape [28]/numel 28, then recomputing each sequence SHA, returns status PASS, RMS_PASS and INTEGRATED_PASS.
blockers.cause: compare_gate_reports.py checks only that G1 contains five all_gather_into_tensor records and _without_owner_exchange removes all such records. It never authenticates those records against ownership.summary.shard_elements, world_size, dtype, or the exact established exchange position per update.
blockers.required_fix: Validate each of the exactly five owner exchanges on every hybrid rank before normalization: input float32 [shard_elements]/numel shard_elements, output float32 [world_size * shard_elements]/numel world_size * shard_elements, exact expected ordering relative to the shared collective sequence, and no other all-gather. Reject malformed, misplaced, extra, or missing gathers. Bind shard_elements and the complete ownership inventory schema fail-closed. Add the committed adversarial regression and rerun the full suite.

request_finalization_requirements: Do not finalize or execute G0, G1, or G2 while B1 is unresolved; independently verify the corrected comparator and observer/inventory binding first.

Finalize distinct immutable arm requests only after a PASS, binding exact final HEAD, request/auth hashes, gate source/observer/comparator/model-check hashes, candidate/prepare hashes, unique paths/caches, exact argv/env, trn21 identity, disk thresholds, and bounded process-group quiescence/evidence lifecycle.

Each final request must state one independently reviewed outer timeout long enough for compile plus the 1800-second in-process ceiling, and fail closed through bounded process-group TERM/KILL/reap/quiescence before artifact hashing.
G1 remains non-executable until the exact G0 archive and clean postflight are retrieved, hashed, committed, and bound; G2 likewise remains non-executable until the exact G1 evidence is bound.

A native comparison requires comparator PASS and model-check PASS over authenticated immutable archives; no result authorizes full A1, training, submission, checkpoint pruning, or cache cleanup by itself.
